objectives.text: Connect a Java program to the learner-local PostgreSQL database through pgJDBC and DriverManager, reading connection settings from environment variables and closing every resource with try-with-resources

Implement a JDBC repository behind the existing repository interface, binding every value with PreparedStatement parameters and running a multi-statement change as one transaction that commits or rolls back as a unit
Run the provided public tests against an isolated test database that the tests create and drop, and use a failing test to locate and fix a repository bug
